question: Should OpenClaw accept `currentTokenCount` plus the SDK token-budget helpers as a narrow public ContextEngine/plugin SDK contract now, or fold that signal into the broader assemble metadata design tracked by #82137?
rationale: The change is a public plugin API and SDK export surface, and related RFC #82137 proposes a broader assemble metadata contract on the same extension point.

options.title: Accept Narrow Contract After Proof
options.body: Approve `currentTokenCount` now, then require the docs map, SDK surface budget, and redacted real-behavior proof before merge.

options.title: Fold Into RFC #82137
options.body: Pause or close this PR and handle token headroom together with the broader provenance/internal-event assemble metadata contract.

options.title: Keep Helpers Private For Now
options.body: Avoid new SDK exports until maintainers settle the permanent plugin API shape and compatibility plan.

recommendation.title: Accept Narrow Contract After Proof
recommendation.body: Approve `currentTokenCount` now, then require the docs map, SDK surface budget, and redacted real-behavior proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned to the PR and have the strongest recent history on the exact context-engine budgeting/assemble path.
